items.title_cn: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.summary_cn: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

items.title_cn: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.title_en: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
items.summary_cn: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
